translations.from: Browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need to provide shipping and payment information to complete your purchase.
translations.to: 浏览我们的商品，将商品加入购物车并前往结账。完成购买需要提供收货与支付信息。

translations.from: How do I place an order?
Yes, you can modify or cancel your order before it's shipped. Once your order is processed, you can't make changes.
translations.to: 可以，在订单发货前你可以修改或取消。订单一旦进入处理流程，将无法再更改。

translations.from: Can I modify or cancel my order?
translations.to: 可以修改或取消订单吗？

translations.from: We accept all major credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
translations.to: 我们接受主流信用卡，包括 Visa、Mastercard 和 American Express。

translations.from: What payment methods do you accept?
Shipping costs vary based on your location and the size of your order. We offer free shipping for orders over $50.
translations.to: 运费因收货地址与订单体积而异。订单满 50 美元可享受免运费。

translations.from: Yes, we ship to most countries. Please check our shipping rates and policies for more information.
translations.to: 是的，我们可向多数国家/地区发货。请查看运费说明与政策了解更多信息。

translations.from: If you're not satisfied with your purchase, you can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Please contact our customer support team for assistance.
translations.to: 若对购买不满意，可在购买后 30 天内申请退款。请联系客服团队协助处理。

translations.from: How do I request a refund?
Check out our latest updates including dark mode support and improved accessibility features.
translations.to: 查看我们的最新更新，包括深色模式支持与改进的无障碍体验。
